items.title: Martin Marietta Materials’s (NYSE:MLM) Q3 2026: beats on revenue
items.summary: Construction materials supplier Martin Marietta Materials (NYSE:MLM) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue rising 28.3% year on year to $2.37 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $7.8 billion, close to analysts’ consensus estimates. Its GAAP profit of $3.94 per share was 18.4% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
